searchText: is it possible to recover a deposit with invalid signature? If the signature is invalid, the deposit is pretty much burned ok that's not good xD yeah lol time to start cataloguing the ways you can lose your funds? probably useful for potential stakers, things that immediately come to mind: - Bad deposit signature - Bad withdrawal hash - Double signing attestation/blocks - Lose access to validating/withdrawal keys ( although this maybe too obvious). Could also add sending to incorrect contract address, depending on where you want to draw the line. There are areas that aren't losing funds, but losing access to funds with no benefit. For example: - sending multiple deposits >32 Ether to the same validator pubkey - sending <32 Ether to a validator pubkey - exiting a validator
